rows.label: α leakage
rows.description: Donor leakage into the red (acceptor) channel.

rows.label: β flux ratio
rows.description: Excitation-flux ratio of the acceptor laser to the donor laser. 1 is the balanced, neutral value — at 0 the acceptor laser excites nothing and the acceptor-excitation channel drops out entirely.

rows.label: δ direct exc.
rows.description: Direct excitation of the acceptor by the donor laser.

rows.label: G factor
rows.description: Polarization detection ratio, parallel over perpendicular.

rows.label: R₀ (Å)
rows.description: Förster radius of the dye pair.

rows.label: Period (ns)
rows.description: Laser repetition period for periodic convolution. 0 uses the full micro-time window.

sections.label: ⟳ Periodic convolution
sections.description: Model the finite laser repetition period: the previous pulse's decay tail wraps into the window (fixes the ramp/offset in the residuals).

options.title: Instrument parameters
options.text:
**Instrument / calibration parameters** are pre-populated from the selected setup (the setup picker at the top) and used by the auto-fit and the FRET-species decays.

- **α, β, γ, δ** — the Hellenkamp correction factors: α donor leakage into the red channel, β the excitation-flux ratio of the acceptor to the donor laser (**1** for a balanced setup — 0 switches the acceptor-excitation channel off entirely), γ the detection/quantum-yield correction, δ direct acceptor excitation by the donor laser. Measure them with the *Accurate FRET* tool and store them on the setup; they are read back here.
- **G, l₁, l₂** — polarization calibration (G-factor detection ratio and the two mixing factors) used when *Pol* is on so anisotropy and lifetimes are fit together.
- **R₀** — Förster radius (Å).
- **Laser period** — enables periodic (wrap-around) convolution.
